prediction.raw: 0. I think it's wrong to pay someone to proofread your paper for college because it can be considered a form of academic dishonesty. In academic settings, it's expected that students will do their own work and submit original writing. Paying someone to proofread your paper can be seen as a way of outsourcing your work and not taking responsibility for your own learning. Additionally, proofreading is an important part of the writing process, and doing it yourself can help you learn and improve your writing skills. By paying someone to do it for you, you may be missing out on the opportunity to learn and grow as a writer. It's also worth noting that many colleges and universities have policies against academic dishonesty, and paying someone to proofread your paper could potentially be considered a violation of these policies. It's always best to do your own work and seek help from your instructor or a tutor if you need it, rather than paying someone to do it for you.
